title: McAllister House Museum

services.name: Tour Times
services.desc: Several generations of the McAllister family placed the highest value on education of their children. All three of the Major’s children attended good schools, and the two daughters were teachers in Colorado Springs. Our tours are about 1 hour in duration and are available to youth of all ages.
